name: Shinigami+Tenshi ~Death Angel~
original_name: 死神+天使～デス・エンジェル～
source:
"Your life... ends here."

A social media app called "Cloudy" was all the rage—where people chatted by sending virtual balloons.
But then, a chilling rumor spread:

"If you get a balloon from the 'Grim Reaper'... you die.
And there are always warning signs."

At first, Nagahisa Towa didn’t believe it.
Until the day the signs started appearing...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15450]Freem[/url]]
translation:
“你的生命……到此结束。”

一款名为“Cloudy”的社交媒体应用程序风靡一时，人们通过发送虚拟气球进行聊天。
但随后，一个令人毛骨悚然的谣言流传开来：

“如果你从‘死神’那里得到一个气球……你就会死。
而且总是有警告信号。”

起初，东和永久并不相信。
直到迹象开始出现的那一天……
